# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment fact documents generated for this report.

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - Application architecture and component relationship diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - External dependency inventory and compatibility observations.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, endpoint inventory, and communication sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Database configuration, ER model, and data ownership analysis.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, properties inventory, and secrets handling.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Primary business workflows and rule/decision flow documentation.
